metadata.title: Whopping Weekend Warrior, 9/19/07 (Saturday)
metadata.author: by Henry Hook / Edited by Peter Gordon (puzzleeditor@nysun.com)

entries.clue: Discus thrower who won gold in four consecutive Olympics
Gary's "Ambiguously Gay Duo" partner on "Saturday Night Live"
Where people do what Simon says
Parent company of Mail Boxes Etc.
Longtime Oklahoma Sooners head coach Barry
Key witness in the Muff Potter trial
Company with numbered sheep in its ads
Honeymooners' salad, as per an old riddle
One who does knotting all day?
No, no, a thousand times no?
___ Field (former name of Minute Maid Park)
The third one can be shocking
Where "We have met the enemy, and they are ours"
Book whose first of two volumes is titled "Eine Abrechnung"
Lyricist Bert in the Songwriters Hall of Fame
He advised, "Be not the slave of Words"
Tout de ___ (all the same, in French)
It may be far from the point
